name: Yuukage
source:
One of seven "Master Kunoichi", Yuukage travels to Ishgalia in pursuit of a certain creature from her homeland. She forces her pupil Shizuku out of retirement to assist.

[Spoiler] Her outward appearance is deceptive as she requires mana to maintain the physique of a child. As such, she is much older than she looks and comments on how others like her have forgotten what their true appearance is like. After securing the Kirin, Yuukage repays her debt to Orias and company by searching for Gilliam and his party in the dungeons. She succeeds in this regard and later helps save the elder in the underground city when Madram and Zenobia attack. [/Spoiler]

When she's not on duty, Yuukage spends her time playing with Ishgalian children and touring the city. She can also be found on certain dungeon floors selling merchandise to visiting adventurers.
